name: SW-CX1
description:
## Description

"An active subwoofer developed as a super woofer that plays back the ultimate ultra low range without ambiguity.In order to fix the vibration ground completely and to clarify the vibration reference point, it is designed as a weight class with a total weight of 126.7kg (including the amplifier / speaker unit).As a result, the housing is not affected by the standing wave from the unit and is not affected by vibration.33cm cone type woofer is used in the unit.In order to withstand the large amplitude (stroke) required for ultra-low frequency reproduction, the diaphragm uses a straight cone made of 3-layer carbon fiber of 3,000filler plain weave, which is lightweight and highly rigid. In addition to the chamber made of the same material, made of the same material.The magnetic circuit uses strontium ferrite as the main magnet with a diameter of 140mm, and the rear part uses a double magnet system with a diameter of 110mm. In addition, the circuit is closed with a 2mm thick cover to increase the magnetic flux density and provide a high anti-magnetic effect. In addition, the cover part is coated to reduce cover squeal caused by vibration at the time of large input.The damper uses Conex, a heat-resistant polymer fiber, and a double damper system is adopted to further improve dubbing performance and anti-rolling performance.An aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame to improve vibration isolation and vibration system support strength. In addition, by arranging ribs asymmetrically, unnecessary vibration is eliminated from both directions of material and shape.Urethane elastomer is used for the edge to improve linearity.The voice coil bobbin is made of heat-resistant, hard-to-burn, highly rigid polyimide reinforced with glass fiber material.In order to further increase the bobbin strength, Vectran (a trademark of Kuraray Co., Ltd.), a new high-strength heat-resistant polyarylate fiber, is wound with high tension (filament winding) to ensure sufficient strength (10times). In addition, the voice coil is wound with four layers to enable faithful operation even for large inputs.Based on the concept of full-scale ultra-low-frequency reproduction, we have adopted a direct-radiation-type reproduction method for low-frequency reproduction that has a low low-frequency reproduction limit and excellent phase characteristics.The enclosure has an internal volume of 52liters and is large enough for a 33cm screwdriver. It also has a structure (reflector base) that reduces unnecessary high-frequency components by reflecting the sound emitted from the speaker on the bottom surface once, taking advantage of the merits of the direct radiation method.The newly developed NF ceramic enclosure is used for the enclosure.Unlike ordinary fine ceramics, NF Ceramics is a new structural ceramic that is not fired at high temperatures and is produced by chemical bonding using water as a medium. By using NF Ceramics in the enclosure, we have achieved five times the strength, four times the damping capacity, three times the density, three times the density, excellent dimensional accuracy, freedom of shape, and heat, water, and weather resistance.The enclosure structure takes advantage of the moldability of NF ceramics and adopts a 3-piece structure that takes into consideration the vibration of each part. This structure is designed with high precision so that the original performance can be obtained without adjustment by simply stacking.The enclosure also features round-shaped port ducts and a tapered base that prevents standing waves between the baffle and the base and concentrates radiant energy toward the front.The amplifier section has a differential 2-stage parallel push-pull circuit configuration for low-impedance drive and high-gain operation. In addition, it uses a 7,500Ï‰ F Chemicon and a high-capacity transformer.In addition, a large black anodized aluminum heat sink has been adopted to enhance the heat radiation effect at high output, and the casing has a highly rigid double-bridge structure to completely eliminate vibration and external influence.It is equipped with a phase selector switch that enables phase switching to match the amplitude period of the sound waves of the subwoofer and the main speaker.Equipped with a turnover switch, it is possible to switch the most effective turnover point (5points) selected from the results of simulating various speakers.In addition, the cutoff slope is set to a curve of -18dB/oct taking into account the phase.The speaker input terminal / Low/High speaker input level can be switched, and connection can be made by two way speaker cable and audio cord.In addition, two or more units of the SW-CX1can be used by installing a monaural in-out along with the line input.High-purity OFC is used for the wiring of the amplifier and speaker unit.It is equipped with functions such as Bus Boost and S. S. B (Super Subsonic Base).It comes with a remote control and can be operated such as power on/off, volume, turnover, phase, bus boost, and S. S. B."

name: Trio
description:
## Description

"A monaural power amplifier using � drive system.Sigma drive system is adopted, and sigma connection with speakers is possible.The � drive method was devised to prevent distortion caused by the back electromotive voltage generated by the movement of the cone paper (voice coil) of the speaker. The concept of NFB, which had been completed in the amplifier until now, is expanded to the input terminal of the speaker by using four cables. By incorporating both the cable and the input terminal of the speaker as one of the internal wiring of the amplifier, the distortion of the speaker is suppressed. This method realizes an incommensurable high performance with a damping factor of 15000at the 3m � cable.First of all, a unique � cable is installed to connect the + side of the speaker to the feedback point of the power amplifier. This cable controls the input terminal of the speaker so that various kinds of distortion, including reverse distortion caused by the magnetic circuit of the speaker, are not generated. The � cable is also installed on the - side. The ground point and power loop of the - side cable are separated. This eliminates the potential difference between the input terminal of the speaker and the ground point.Current mirror 3-stage amplification is adopted for the pre-driver stage, and by using current mirror load, naked gain of the amplifier is taken large, and distortion factor is greatly reduced.Both positive and negative cycles of the signal source impedance that drives the output stage at the same time are made equal, and the time constant of the rise and fall of the square wave is made equal to realize high-speed characteristics.All signal paths, including the NF loop, use a DC amplifier configuration that does not have a time constant due to a capacitor to stabilize low-frequency characteristics, and a newly designed high-speed circuit and high-fTBy using a transistor, the range is expanded to the ultra-high band.Delta VGSThe offset voltage is reduced by adopting the dual FET with less offset voltage and sufficient loop gain is secured. Since the dual FET contains FETs with the same characteristics in one package, the two FETs change in the same state even with temperature drift. This compensates for offset drift with an excellent accuracy of ¥20mv even at -10Ï‰ to + 60?.It uses particle board on the bottom and non-magnetic aluminum die-cast on the back panel through which signals pass.Although the transformer is inside the housing, the new design achieves the same effect as a separate housing, reducing the occurrence of magnetic distortion, which adversely affects the signal system.The power supply uses a large-capacity transformer and two capacitors of 12,000Ï‰ F, which are resistant to current fluctuations.Equipped with an ASO detection type current limiter, it protects the transistor when the output is short-circuited and weakens the limiter effect when the speaker is connected to prevent noise.Equipped with speaker protection, the relay operates after the circuit stabilizes after the power is turned on, so that no excessive power is applied to the speakers. name: Trio
description:
## Description

"A monaural power amplifier that uses a � drive system between a preamplifier and a power amplifier, and between an amplifier and a speaker.The L-08M is a model with a three dimensional design, and uses a design with a machine Nomi in which the entire body is a heat sink.Sigma drive system is adopted, and sigma connection with speakers is possible.The � drive method was devised to prevent distortion caused by the back electromotive voltage generated by the movement of the cone paper (voice coil) of the speaker. The concept of NFB, which had been completed in the amplifier until now, is expanded to the input terminal of the speaker by using four cables. By incorporating both the cable and the input terminal of the speaker as one of the internal wiring of the amplifier, the distortion of the speaker is suppressed. This method realizes an incommensurable high performance with a damping factor of 15000at the 3m � cable.First of all, a unique � cable is installed to connect the + side of the speaker to the feedback point of the power amplifier. This cable controls the input terminal of the speaker so that various kinds of distortion, including reverse distortion caused by the magnetic circuit of the speaker, are not generated. The � cable is also installed on the - side. The ground point and power loop of the - side cable are separated. This eliminates the potential difference between the input terminal of the speaker and the ground point.The L-08M allows a � connection between the preamplifier and power amplifier.In the conventional separate amplifier, there are various capacitances between the windings of the transformer. In the high-frequency region, the primary side and the secondary side are completely electrostatically coupled. In addition, the primary side of the preamplifier and the primary side of the power amplifier are in the same state as if they were connected through an AC cord. In addition, the home AC power supply, which has long indoor wiring, has a considerably high impedance. When the power amplifier drives the speaker, the voltage drop occurs and the secondary side voltage fluctuates. This electrostatic coupling and electromagnetic coupling due to voltage fluctuation create a current loop consisting of the power transformer of the power amplifier Ï‰ the power transformer of the preamplifier Ï‰ the ground of the preamplifier Ï‰ the ground of the power amplifier Ï‰ the power transformer of the power amplifier. The potential difference generated in the ground connection cable due to the current flowing in this loop enters the power amplifier and is amplified, and is input to the speaker with a distortion that cannot be ignored in the sense of hearing.In the Sigma connection, the Sigma cable between the earth and the ground acts as an exclusive bypass for the power loop generated by mutual interference between the power transformers and does not affect the signal system. Therefore, when the pre-power and the power are connected, the potential between the earth and the ground is matched. This makes it possible to connect in accordance with the original purpose of the separate amplifier, enabling faithful signal transmission.The voltage amplification stage has a configuration that employs a fully symmetrical upper and lower circuit.The input stage consists of a single-chip, dual-FET source follower. The first stage amplifier consists of a single-chip, dual-transistor cascode output, and the second stage amplifier consists of a dual-transistor differential input cascode output. This circuit has superior temperature characteristics and is fully symmetrical in the upper and lower sides. This configuration realizes flat and bare frequency characteristics up to the ultra-high frequency range. This configuration ensures sufficient NF quantity in the high frequency range, which has been allowed to cause switching distortion due to the decrease in bare gain, and surprisingly low distortion rate is obtained over the entire band. In addition, transient characteristics are greatly improved and TIM distortion is suppressed.It uses a super-large chimney type radiator and efficiently radiates the heat produced by the high power of 170W.In addition, magnetic distortion is greatly improved by making it non-magnetic aluminum die-cast.The input of the power amplifier goes between the hot input terminal and ground, and the output goes between the speaker terminal and ground. In conventional power amplifiers, the ground terminal of the NF loop that controls the output is shared with the ground terminal of the input. Therefore, a certain amount of current flows between the ground terminal of the input and the ground, causing the damping factor and distortion to deteriorate.In the � drive system, feedback is directly applied from the input terminal of the speaker for both hot and ground. Therefore, only a small amount of current flows between the input and output ground, which is negligible compared to the load current. Therefore, the signal path is not interfered by current, and an excellent output waveform similar to the input waveform can be obtained.The power supply for the power amplifier stage, which requires strong energy, is completely separated from the power supply for the voltage amplifier stage, which operates with constant current and minute current, including the basic transformer. This eliminates interference from the power amplifier stage to the class A amplifier stage through the power supply circuit, and transmits pure signals to the subsequent stage.The L-08M was sold separately as an exclusive power transformer L-08PS.The L-08PS is an enhanced power transformer with a built-in high-capacity transformer of 260VA, which has the same capacity as the internal power supply. It can be added as many as you want using a one touch connector. This allows you to increase the capacity of the power supply to 520VA, 780VA, 1040VA, etc., thus improving sound quality.By adding L-08PS, the power up of L-08M becomes 220W (1piece), 240W (2pieces), 250W (3pieces or more) at 8�."

name: KENWOOD
description:
## Description

"A multi-channel AV amplifier that supports Dolby Digital and DTS.Supports DTS (Digital Theater Systems), a digital surround format.The compression density of DTS is about 1/ 4of that of Dolby Digital (average), and the average data rate per second is high, so that the amount of information is larger.It is compatible with 5.1ch Dolby digital surround by adopting 24bit precision DSP chip.Also equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and Dolby 3stereo, you can enjoy a variety of surround playback depending on the source.In addition, it is equipped with the Midnight Theater Mode, which is useful for Dolby digital playback when the sound volume cannot be reproduced in the middle of the night. Temperature correction, which used to take several minutes, can now be performed almost instantly. name: K270
description:
## Description

"A large integrated audio system that combines an amplifier, CD player, and tuner.The final transistor of the amplifier section is equipped with TRAITR, a unique device of Kenwood.This is the world'Ωs first single-chip temperature detection and compensation circuit. It is a final transistor with five terminals. Since the temperature detection element is placed on the same chip as the transistor, the temperature can be detected almost in real time. The distortion caused by a small signal due to the change of the operating point, which occurs when the conventional temperature detection transistor is attached to the radiator, is suppressed.In order to make the most of the capabilities of the TRAITR, we have adopted a super linear drive circuit that reduces the switching distortion and crossover distortion generated in the final stage circuit by local feedback to the driver stage. This ensures stable operation of the main NFB circuit.We have also adopted a linear TRAITR circuit based on TRAITR'Ωs concept. An operational amplifier is used for the first stage circuit of the amplifier. The dynamic linearity of the first stage circuit is improved by taking advantage of the feature that both functions and temperature operate in the same chip.An a-class amplifier and a current detection feedback circuit are installed to improve close range and low volume playback.In principle, the A-class amplifier does not cause crossover distortion or asymmetric distortion, so the linearity of the small signal level is improved.In addition, the current detection feedback circuit (CNFB) is a circuit that reduces distortion by detecting the distortion component of the speaker from the current flowing in the speaker and feeding it back to the input side, while the NFB reduces distortion by returning the opposite component from the output of the amplifier to the input. This circuit reduces distortion in the low range by detecting the distortion component of the speaker from the current flowing in the speaker and feeding it back to the input side.An elliptical ring core toroidal transformer is used for the power supply.There is little leakage of magnetic flux, sound is smooth, and does not affect surrounding circuits. In addition, power conversion efficiency is improved by the elliptic structure in which the winding can be wound tightly.The CD player is equipped with a 24-bit Fine D. R. I. V. E. that achieves 64times higher precision than the conventional 24-bit 8-fs D. R. I. V. E. This allows even minute signals, which were previously discarded as digital noise, to be sent to the 24-bit D/A converter with data closer to the original sound, improving the sense of reality and solidity.In addition, two independent transformers for digital and analog systems, and pure CD direct inside the chassis are used to improve sound quality.The tuner section has a 4-row front end to improve reception characteristics.The 40station preset and timer preset and timer functions improve operability.A shutter mechanism is adopted as a sound pressure shielding structure.Equipped with an SP equalizer that can be turned ON/OFF depending on where the speaker is set.CD-TEXT is supported."

description:
## Description

"This is a cassette deck equipped with a newly developed DBS in addition to a SuperTLLE with an original constant current drive system.An amorphous head has been adopted for the head part.The head core consists of 13layers of 45Ï‰ ultra-thin sheets of amorphous alloy, which has excellent characteristics. This structure reduces eddy currents and extends the high-frequency range. Moreover, transmission characteristics are improved by using oxygen-free copper for the winding, and purer sound is realized.In addition, the KX-0D uses a large amorphous head with less magnetic saturation. Since the core is large, it can generate a strong magnetic field and at the same time improve the head touch of the tape. 880d uses a large amorphous head with less magnetic saturation.Uses Super TLLE (twin loop linear exciter), a constant current drive system unique to Kenwood.This system has two loops for head drive and gain control, and is directly connected to the recording head DC with ¥2power supplies. This configuration eliminates current transmission loss in the high-frequency range, making it possible to record high-quality, thick sound. In addition, by eliminating output resistance, the dynamic range of the recording amplifier has been improved by 12dB to 13dB (400Hz) compared to the conventional system. In addition, since the head drive current does not depend on the impedance change of the head, phase degradation does not occur, and current distortion caused by load fluctuation can be suppressed. Since the recording head is directly connected to DC, flat recording is possible down to the ultra-low frequency range.It is equipped with a newly developed DBS (dynamic bias system).In the past, high-frequency recording performance was degraded due to loss caused by eddy currents generated in the core material of the magnetic circuit, current loss in the magnetic material, and self-demagnetization caused by the head erasing data while recording by itself due to the running of the tape. As a result, when recording at a high level of 0dB, the high-frequency characteristic suddenly drops from about 1kHz, and when attempting to increase the frequency characteristic by lowering the recording level by 10dB or 20dB, the SN ratio deteriorates.To solve this problem, Kenwood paid attention to the fact that the high-frequency component works to deepen the recording bias. When high-frequency and large-amplitude signals are received, the bias current is reduced to raise the MOL (maximum magnetic flux density), and at the same time, a unique method was added to prevent self-demagnetization. Thus, the high-frequency MOL characteristics have been greatly improved. Furthermore, since a feedback loop is not used in the circuit for reducing the bias current, there is no time constant. In addition, the high-frequency range with good sharpness is realized by following Sharp even in momentary large input signals such as attack sounds.High-rigidity silent mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.This mechanism was developed by analyzing vibration modes from various angles. In the KX-880D, this mechanism has been further pursued. First of all, by simplifying the mechanism itself, a metal shaft is used as a guide for fixing the cassette, and a metal with high rigidity is used for the head base for mounting the head.As a result, the internal disturbance of the mechanism itself caused by the motor and disturbance transmitted through the case are suppressed to the limit, and stable head touch of the tape is realized.A newly developed low torque ripple motor is used as the drive motor.The torque fluctuation of the motor caused unstable tape running and degraded the wow flutter. Computer analysis of the motor used in the KX-880D reduced the torque fluctuation to 1/2that of conventional motors.In addition, the motor drive circuit has been newly developed, and the noise component generated by the motor rotating is removed by the motor drive circuit with clear grounding, and the impact of the middle and low range sound is enhanced.Equipped with bias calibration and rec calibration. By adjusting for each tape, it is possible to use all tapes under optimum conditions.The recording circuit, reproducing circuit, and Dolby B/C circuit all use an op-amp type � power supply circuit. Clear sound is realized by clarifying the ground potential of 0.In addition, the power supply section uses a constant voltage power supply of � Route 3to eliminate interference between components, especially since no power ripple is applied to the recording circuit, excellent sound localization can be obtained.Equipped with a Dolby B/C type noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit uses a new dedicated IC and circuit to improve dynamic characteristics.Equipped with left and right independent preset volumes and master volumes.This allows you to set the recording level independently on the left and right sides. After adjusting the level of the left and right sides, you can adjust the recording level in conjunction with the master volume.Equipped with New DPSS (Direct Program Search System) with fast response speed.With this function, you can perform various functions such as music selection functions such as starting one song before or after or starting the desired song, repeated performance functions such as one song repeat / one side repeat, Re-rec standby which rewind to the beginning of the song when you want to rerecord it after starting recording, rewinding play which starts from the beginning of the tape when it ends halfway, 0stop which automatically rewind to the position where the counter is reset, index scan, blank search, auto-rec mute, etc.The 4-digit linear counter is a multi-function display which can be switched as a DPSS indicator and a residual quantity indicator.Equipped with a wide-range 16-point FL peak hold level meter that displays from -36dB to + 12dB.Equipped with a linear tape counter that shows the tape running fee and remaining tape amount.It is a high-precision 4-digit digital tape counter that detects time with a microcomputer. It also functions as a residual quantity meter with a blank search function, and it also functions as a track number display during DPSS operation.It is equipped with FL display.The capacity of the electrolytic capacitor in the power supply has been doubled compared with the conventional model.Equipped with an auto tape selector.Equipped with MPX filter.Equipped with a headphone level volume."

name: KX-990SR
description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck equipped with an original constant current drive system Super TLLE.A head base stabilizer is used to fix the rotating head, an erasing head seesaw operation structure is used to stabilize the tape path, and a low torque ripple filter is used to reduce torque fluctuations, thereby achieving stable driving.The head is equipped with a unique head base stabilizer to prevent modulation noise caused by rattling and delicate vibration.This head base stabilizer secures the head to the appropriate azimuth point by means of a groove cut into the head mount and a stainless steel spring. In addition, subtle differences in tape travel positions between FWD and REV are adjusted by the tape guide attached to the erase head for each direction. Thus, smooth driving is achieved.In this method, the erase head does not enter between the recording / reproducing head, which requires stable travel, and the capstan and pinch roller, which drive the tape at a constant speed. Therefore, tape path performance equivalent to that of one way tape is obtained.In order to prevent the fluctuation of motor torque from causing unstable tape running and deterioration of the wow flutter, computer analysis was carried out to use a low torque ripple motor that reduces the fluctuation of torque to less than 1/2that of conventional motors.The Super TLLE, a unique constant-current drive circuit developed from the conventional TLLE, is adopted.The head drive amplifier has been strengthened to reduce head current distortion in the high-frequency range and to further expand the dynamic range.New amorphous head with oxygen-free copper is used for the head.Equipped with a level meter that displays up to -36dB.Equipped with New DPSS capable of easy operation for both FWD and REW running.In addition to the black model, there was also a silver model."

description:

name: D-3300P
description:
## Description

"A CD player equipped with a digital output to enable digital transmission to external D/A converters in order to take advantage of the quality of light.It is equipped with optical digital and coaxial digital outputs so that it can be output as digital.The coaxial output uses a pulse transformer for electrical isolation between devices to prevent audio signal degradation due to noise generated in the earth loop.It is also possible to turn off the power supply for the D/A converter and analog section that are not required during digital transmission.It is equipped with a multi-insulation system with the theme of accurately tracing the pit without transmitting disturbance to the pickup.First of all, an approximately 1kg aluminum die-cast integrally molded mount is adopted for the base part supporting the mechanism to suppress external vibration transmitted to the chassis, clarify the grounding point of the mechanism, and improve the mounting accuracy of the mechanism. In addition, the mechanism itself is mounted using a special elastic insulator method, and vibration isolation materials are used for the main parts of the mechanism to further strengthen the vibration isolation structure.In addition, coil springs and a Howbrid insulator made of an elastic body are used to support the pickup to improve the prevention of pick-up movement.In addition, a highly rigid and heavy cabinet with a 3-mm-thick bottom plate and aluminum extruding is adopted. This ensures high rigidity and reduces sound pressure and floor vibration by weight.In addition, we have newly developed an insulator that prevents the transmission of vibrations by using a two layered cushion made of a combination of two types of materials, soft and hard.In addition, it uses a weight stabilizer of 300g each made of a material resistant to vibration.The signal processing section between the digital and analog signals in the CD player, the data line of the D/A converter section, the mute signal, and the emphasis signal are equipped with photo-couplers. The ground of the digital and analog sections is completely separated.First of all, by optically transmitting the mute and emphasis control signals, the digital current is returned to the digital GND and grounded. Therefore, the digital noise that enters the high-impedance pattern that draws the mute and emphasis signals is not transmitted to the analog signal system.In addition, the data line with the highest frequency among the interface system from the digital part to the analog part and with many higher harmonic components is also used for optical transmission. Therefore, dirty current including harmonics is returned to the root of the power supply by a dedicated return circuit and is not transmitted to the analog signal system.This optical transmission and the independent power supply system of each unit realizes sound with excellent SN feeling.The D/A converter section is equipped with a digital filter with 4x oversampling, so that the spectrum of 44.1kHz, 88.2kHz and 132.3kHz is significantly attenuated and transmitted to the D/A converter. Therefore, a slow low-pass filter can be used to improve sound quality.The D/A converter is equipped with a left / right independent ladder network type D/A converter. In this ladder network type, the conversion accuracy is determined in part by the accuracy of the current source and resistance inside the IC.With the D-3300P, we have completed a D/A converter integrated circuit in which conversion accuracy is pursued by laser trimming. Since the high-speed D/A converter configuration is capable of handling 4times over sampling, there is no ?????, and the degrizer circuit, which was indispensable until now, is eliminated.The low-pass filter uses a 7th-order Butterworth filter with less in-band ripple and excellent phase characteristics, and the FDNR configuration with no active elements in the signal path improves the SN ratio.When there is a scratch on the disk, the servo gain is instantaneously lowered to 0level. When the disk passes the scratch, the servo gain is increased. The bit is accurately traced. The TypeIII optimal servo control is adopted. This design is resistant to vibration, scratches and dirt.The power supply for the analog section, servo system, digital processing system and D/A converter is separated from the transformer winding and independent of each other to eliminate power supply fluctuation caused by mutual interference.Some CDs have an absolute phase at the time of recording, but when they track down, they become reversed phase. In order to enjoy this CD in positive phase, an invert switch which can invert the phase by 180� is installed.This circuit inverts the phase of the music signal at the stage of digital data, so there is no degradation of sound quality.It is equipped with functions such as a music calendar that displays track numbers of up to 20songs, direct selection with 10keys and plus 10keys, 4modes of track play, single play, program play, and time play, auto open that automatically opens the tray when the performance ends, auto close that automatically closes the tray if the tray is left open for 5minutes, and power on play for timer play.Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"A CD player with multi-insulation system.Reading performance is improved by suppressing disturbance and internal vibration through a multi-insulation system.The mechanism mount uses a special elastic insulator to block vibration from the disk motor generated inside the mechanism. In addition, the mechanism mount section has a double structure to increase rigidity and eliminate vibration over a wide band.The power supply section and construction have been thoroughly reviewed, and the analog section after the digital filter has been made into a twin monaural configuration. This eliminates interference between the left and right and between the front and rear sections and improves performance.The digital filter is a 2x oversampling digital filter with excellent inband rejection and inband ripple characteristics. This makes it possible to use an analog filter with moderate characteristics, providing excellent sound quality and performance.A 16-bit linear D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.In the power supply section, we have further developed a power supply system using a large-capacity multi-power supply. In addition to using a D/A converter independent power supply with a dedicated winding for the D/A converter section, we have also installed large-capacity power supplies for the digital, servo, and display systems to eliminate noise pollution caused by mutual interference through the power supply.In addition, the newly developed ARPS circuit clarifies and stabilizes the analog of the D/A converter itself, eliminating the interference between digital and analog systems occurring inside the IC.A 3-beam high-precision, low-noise, high-cost pickup with a highly precise pickup section has been adopted.The DP 990d uses a self-pulse-modulated oscillation laser to reduce operating noise caused by mode-competition noise and to prevent it from being introduced into the audio circuit. The optical system uses an objective lens with a wave aberration of Ï‰ / 40(? Ï‰ 0.78Ï‰ m) to improve precision and efficiency, making it possible to read signals with high S/N ratio.This pickup is compensated by a servo mechanism to provide excellent tracing capability. In addition, high rigidity is achieved by integrating the laser drive circuit with the pickup. In particular, the signal reader is floated by an insulator to shut out vibration from outside and inside, reducing the load on the servo circuit.Optimal Servo Control Type III is used for the servo circuit.In this circuit, a preset error voltage is applied to the servo system so that when there is a scratch on the disk, no extra force is applied to the pickup and the disk passes through the scratch. description:

description:
## Description

"A compact disc player developed as an audio device that takes advantage of digital sources by adopting an enhanced D/A converter and an optimal servocontrol.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit integration type D/A converter.In this D/A converter, it is necessary to read data correctly in a certain amount of time. reproducing audio signals that are faithful to digital signal data.In order to improve the sound quality of the D/A converter and the analog section that follows it, we have invested the sound quality know-how obtained from Trio'Ωs amplifier and tuner technologies.First, the digital signal processing section and the analog signal processing section each have independent power supply circuits to description:
## Description

"A CD player that pursues audio in an orthodox way.The mechanism section is equipped with an eccentric absorption mechanism unique to Kenwood. By setting the disk at the rotation center point, the bare nature of the mechanism is improved, and the reading accuracy is improved without extra burden on the servo.The DP-2000has an eccentric absorption mechanism that keeps the disk level by placing a ring-shaped magnet on the disk clamper and uniformly mounting the disk. Also, a center guide made of brass is used around the Center shaft. This center guide has a structure that floats and sinks by a compression coil spring, so it floats when playing a disk with a large center hole, and sinks when playing a disk with a small center hole.This eccentric absorption mechanism clamps the disk firmly as a highly rigid rotation mechanism, so that the disk can be rotated while maintaining the rotation center point at all times, improving the reading accuracy.Optimal servocontrol is used for the servo circuit.This circuit automatically detects scratches or dust on the disc, controls the servo amount from just before the scratch, and returns to the original servo amount when the disc passes through the defective part. Therefore, the RF signal of the disc is reproduced accurately with almost no tracking error.The output stage employs a twin output configuration using a cascade feedback amplifier to eliminate interference between the left and right channels to obtain a low distortion factor and high separation. The low-pass filter employs a newly developed in-house filter with improved performance using a discrete configuration to obtain excellent characteristics with a distortion factor less than the measurement limit.It is equipped with a FIR (Finite Impulse Response) type digital filter excellent in unwanted band cut-off characteristics and in-band ripple characteristics.In the digital data stage of this filter, unnecessary bands from 24.1kHz to 64.1kHz are cut off by more than 80dB. Therefore, the order of the analog filter in the latter stage can be reduced, and group delay characteristics that are easily disturbed are greatly improved.In addition, the D/A converter is equipped with a cascade amplifier feedback circuit to greatly improve the distortion factor and SN ratio.The Unilinear converter system fully synchronizes all digital processing sections of the digital signal processing section, digital filter and D/A converter with one type of clock.The D/A converter block is a 16-bit integration type with a constant current drive circuit for integration.A newly developed insulator is used for the leg part to suppress external vibration and reduce unnecessary burden on the servo circuit.The power supply section employs a 2-transformer 4-winding 11-power supply configuration to eliminate mutual interference through the power supply.In addition, the D/A converter block is more focused and is supported by two shunt regulators and four series regulators powered.Uses a 4-pole 5-slot large torque motor with less cogging for disk rotation and pickup feed.This motor achieves sharp rotation with less eccentricity by improving axial performance.The pickup section uses a 3-beam type pickup in which 3beams are applied obliquely to the track direction.In this method, the signal is read by the center beam, and the track offset is detected in real time by the two ends. In addition, the vibration characteristics of the actuator that moves the objective lens are improved to realize high-precision tracing.In order to enjoy CD in positive phase, it is equipped with an invert output which can invert the phase by 180�.This function inverts the phase of the music signal at the stage of digital data, so there is no degradation of sound quality.Subcode output terminal is mounted.It is equipped with functions such as manual search, jump selection, random play of up to 16songs, memory repeat of a specific section, reservation of the next song with reserve key, space creation for about 4seconds with space key, auto pause, and memory repeat of all songs.Wireless remote control is included.

It can smoothly output low-level abnormal signals with a 20-bit resolution in the calculation process. However, it could not obtain sufficient effect in the region below the low-level, and it could only obtain output close to the original 16-bit signal.To solve this problem, the D. R. I. V. E. system uses real-time processing (a technique that processes all music signals instantaneously) using adaptive filter technology to improve micro-level reproducibility and responsiveness to impulsive sounds such as attack sounds.The D. R. I. V. E. processor is located between the 8x Oversampling &Ω20x digital filter and the 20-bit data input D/A converter. It is processed so that the output from the digital filter is always 20-bit accurate even in the range where only 16-bit accuracy can be obtained.The internal section consists of a low-pass filter and a delay unit with cutoff frequencies within different audible frequency bands. The delay unit adjusts the amount of delay generated by the low-pass filter. Data from the digital filter is distributed from the input terminal, input to each delay unit, and then input to each LPF. Next, a selector control circuit constantly detects the frequency component and level of the input data and selects the optimum LPF output.This makes it possible to drive the D/A converter with 20-bit accuracy at all times.An advanced high precision master clock is used as the master clock.This oscillation circuit uses a discrete circuit to obtain a high-purity clock signal. (Dynamic Resolution Intensive Vector Enhancement) system, which was developed using original signal processing technology, to improve digital processing of music signals from small level to near silence.The conventional digital filter aims to remove unnecessary components outside the audible band included in the original digital signal. It can smoothly output low-level abnormal signals with a 20-bit resolution in the calculation process. However, it could not obtain sufficient effect in the region below the low-level, and it could only obtain output close to the original 16-bit signal.To solve this problem, the D. R. I. V. E. system uses real-time processing (a technique that processes all music signals instantaneously) using adaptive filter technology to improve micro-level reproducibility and responsiveness to impulsive sounds such as attack sounds.The D. R. I. V. E. processor is located between the 8x Oversampling &Ω20x digital filter and the 20-bit data input D/A converter. It is processed so that the output from the digital filter is always 20-bit accurate even in the range where only 16-bit accuracy can be obtained.The internal section consists of a low-pass filter and a delay unit with cutoff frequencies within different audible frequency bands. The delay unit adjusts the amount of delay generated by the low-pass filter. Data from the digital filter is distributed from the input terminal, input to each delay unit, and then input to each LPF. Next, a selector control circuit constantly detects the frequency component and level of the input data and selects the optimum LPF output.This makes it possible to drive the D/A converter with 20-bit accuracy at all times.The D/A converter uses a bit stream 1-bit D/A converter (DAC7) with excellent differential linearity.High signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) is obtained by adopting the PDM method in which the 1-bit pulse density is changed according to the CD data. This PDM waveform accurately drives the switched-capacitor integrator placed at the later stage.The 1-bit D/A converter is a method for restoring analog signals by converting level-axis information into time-axis density. It requires an external clock with high accuracy. However, by using an advanced high-precision master clock as the master clock, accurate operation is obtained.An advanced high precision master clock is used as the master clock.This oscillation circuit uses a discrete circuit to obtain a high-purity clock signal. This circuit is based on a Source Follower circuit and has a characteristic of gain less than 1, so it oscillates an accurate reference signal without amplifying external noise.SuperC developed for Kenwood'Ωs high-end L-series4Is used for the audio stage.This circuit employs a high-precision differential amplifier circuit with a high common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) in the first stage circuit, which is susceptible to noise. This circuit achieves purer signal amplification by preventing noise contamination.Equipped with an accurate linear focus servo.By controlling the pickup actuator so that the optimum DC servo voltage is applied in the direction that follows the appropriate levitation voltage even if it changes, stable operation is always achieved.Digital servo, digital / analog separate winding, OEIC pickup, 1.6mm thick steel chassis, etc. are adopted."

description:
## Description

"The L series CD player was developed with the aim of the new 90'Ωs standard machine.It is designed with high sound quality, such as the pursuit of stable operation during CD playback, review of all internal signal paths, and emphasis on high margin in all parts of the structure and circuit.In order to reduce fluttering caused by warpage and deflection of lightweight CD disks, we have adopted a top-loading system in which a turning table is fixed directly to a spindle motor.In this system, the recording surface is set upward, and the disk is pressed on a smooth ¥130mm aluminum turntable with a clamper weighing approximately 100g. It has a high ability to rotate an LD disk with 20times the mass of a CD disk at about 4to 5times the rotational speed of a CD. It has a diameter three times that of a conventional spindle motor, so servo response and shaft torsion are greatly improved compared to conventional spindle motors for CDs.Super C developed with the L-A1integrated amplifier of the L series4(Super Constant Current Cascode Circuit) is used for the audio stage.Audio stage amplification, which used to be composed of operational amplifier ICs, is composed of a full-scale amplifier of discrete design with an emphasis on performance.Printed circuit boards are made of high-strength glass epoxy boards, which are used as commercial circuit board materials.In addition, the board is mounted on a rigid 2mm thick frame via steel studs to improve reliability.The D/A converter section uses a PDM conversion bit stream 1-bit D/A converter. In addition, an independent switched capacitor on the left and right sides is also installed to reproduce the sound field more finely.The digital filter is an 8x oversampling type.The analog output terminal realizes an ultra-low impedance output of 0.1¥, and suppresses external noise signals superimposed on audio cables more than ever before.In order to prevent interference between the digital and analog systems, separate transformers are installed.In addition, the microcomputer and display tube are supplied with power from a dedicated transformer, creating an ideal power supply for each system.To clarify the moving and reference points, the drive mechanism for the large turntable is mounted on a 4-mm-thick aluminum die-cast chassis and is firmly supported by an 8-mm-thick aluminum extruding mechanism frame fixed in a rigid frame.The front panel is made of 5mm thick aluminum extruding material. The mechanism, digital control, digital / analog power supply, and power supply / analog demodulation sections are separated by 2mm thick steel plates on the body frame and bottom plate to prevent interference between each part and improve the rigidity of the housing.In addition, the top plate is made of 3.8mm thick aluminum extruding material to divide the air chamber at the front part of the body and the air chamber at the rear part to reduce interference caused by radiation and vibration.Panels and keys are made of cutting material or extruded material with sufficient thickness to improve rigidity and reliability.In addition, the pin jack adopts a high-reliability type with gold-plated brass.In order to prevent accidents such as damage caused by incomplete loading of the CD, a clamper detection mechanism is installed that does not start playback unless a clamper is set.3-step door position (opening / closing angle) of 45� / 60� / 80� can be selected for cases where upper space is restricted such as installation on a rack.It has an optical and coaxial digital output with an on/off switch.Equipped with A/B automatic EDIT function considering tape copy.Wireless remote control is included."

"CD transport specialized for digital output.When the DP-X9010was released, the term CD transport was not used yet, so it was regarded as a D/A converter-less CD player.Low center of gravity center mechanism is adopted for internal layout.In this system, the mechanism is laid out in the center and the center of gravity is lowered to keep the balance of the chassis and to prevent the chassis from being twisted due to rotation. ## Description

"FM/AM synthesizer tuner adopting DLLD.It employs a newly developed wide-band linear detection DLLD (direct linear loop detector).This is a detection method in which the 10.7MHz IF signal is directly linearized and detected by a closed-loop detector. In addition, a distortion correction circuit is provided in the closed-loop so that the nonlinear distortion of the VCO and the distortion generated by the IF filter are also reduced to 0.In FM broadcasting, music signals are FM-modulated and transmitted, and the IF signal at 10.7MHz is always moved by this modulation.The DLLD is set so that the VCO moves by the same amount as the change of 10.7mhz by FM modulation, and the error of the output of the phase comparator is always 0, and only the audio signal is taken out.In addition, a distortion correction circuit is adopted to suppress the generation of non-linear distortion, and low-distortion wide-band linear detection is realized.Since the DLLD is a closed-loop detector, the noise generated in the loop is suppressed and the signal-to-noise ratio is improved.It employs a pulse swallow static control method in which the comparison frequency is set to 25kHz, which is outside the audible band.In addition, we have achieved a 98dB SN ratio by increasing the purity of the local oscillator signal using a local oscillator tunable buffer circuit and a twin varactor diode with low noise and excellent large input characteristics.Dual gate MOS FETs are used in the RF amplifier and MIX section to improve intermodulation characteristics.The AM section uses an AM band variable circuit to control the frequency characteristics according to the pre-emphasis amount of each broadcasting station."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"An FM stereo tuner developed by comprehensively pursuing all aspects.The front end uses a single-double-triple-tune configuration, a precision 7-series varicon with reduced tracking error and gang error, and a small-capacity load DD-MOS type FET to achieve excellent interference rejection performance while maintaining low distortion characteristics.The RF stage is a 2-stage amplifier, and the amplifier element uses a DD-MOS type (double diffused dual-gate MOS type) FET, which is an improved version of the dual-gate MOS-FET. The high-frequency characteristics of this FET have been greatly improved by diffusing the conventional MOS-FET once again. In addition, the DD-MOS-FET has superior spurious characteristics and intermodulation characteristics, superior ultra-high-frequency characteristics, superior sensitivity because the noise figure is small, and stable operation can be obtained because the feedback capacity is small.Dual gate MOS-FET is used for the mixer stage.A buffer circuit is used for the station generator to enhance intermodulation and AM suppression.The IF stage is equipped with 2-stage band switching, which achieves both high selectivity characteristics and low distortion rate.The demodulation circuit uses a multi ??????? discriminator system consisting of a Bessel delay device, waveform shaping device and multiplier.The Narrow band consists of three stages of 4-element phase-linear ceramic filters to achieve high selectivity.Uses an 8-pole (4-pole 2-stage) LC concentrated filter with excellent group delay characteristics.In addition, by installing a buffer circuit, deterioration of group delay characteristics due to parameter changes of the amplifying element is suppressed.The loop response of the PLL is automatically switched.The PLL circuit detects the pilot signal from the composite signal. If the loop response of the PLL is fast, the filter action is weakened, and the main signal is mixed into the subcarrier, causing a kind of intermodulation. Therefore, with the loop response automatic switching installed in the KT-7700, the PLL is locked as soon as the stereo indicator lamp lights up, and the input level is lowered to slow the loop response and strengthen the filter action. This greatly reduces the high-frequency distortion during stereo reception.A FET is used in the MPX switching circuit to realize a low distortion factor.The audio amplifier uses a differential direct-coupled ¥2power source operational amplifier.In addition, by driving all audio signal systems after the discri with ¥2power supply, deterioration of distortion hardly occurs even at 300% overmodulation.TRIO'Ωs unique FET switching system D. S. D. C is adopted.In this method, the left and right separation is adjusted independently.A 7-element Norton conversion filter is used for the low-pass filter with an emphasis on the phase characteristics of the audio section.Equipped with de-emphasis circuit of high-precision design.Resistors and capacitors are strictly controlled and selected high-precision elements are used.It is a local oscillation built-in type varicon which integrates the varicon and the local oscillator.In this varicon, a wing for fine tuning of the varicon has been added to keep the rotation angle and local frequency within ¥60khz.In addition, we prevent adverse effects due to moisture absorption of the printed circuit board by using three dimensional wiring for the station and eliminating the printed circuit board.The air-trimmer used for the oscillator circuit is also highly stable, providing a tuner that is resistant to environmental changes.Metal glaze semi-fixed volume and metal film resistance are adopted, and temperature and humidity changes of the separation adjustment part and PLL-VCO adjustment part are suppressed.There was a carrying handle as an option sold separately."

description:
## Description

"Based on Trio'Ωs unique inertial lock and quartz lock, this is a player system with stability transfer in higher dimension.In order to ensure that the center of gravity of the cabinet coincides with the rotation axis of the motor, we have adopted a two layer high rigidity cabinet made of two materials with different resonance frequencies. A particle board and a 6mm thick steel plate are bonded together.Since the shape of the iron material is determined taking into consideration the balance of the entire cabinet, we succeeded in bringing the center of gravity of the cabinet onto the rotating shaft of the motor and obtained stable rotation.In addition, in order to suppress the adverse effect on the cabinet caused by the reaction to the direction of rotation due to mechanical torque change (ripple) called cogging, which is inherent in DC motors, we have improved the rotational accuracy by using insulators that do not move in the horizontal direction.The motor is a converter that converts current into torque. We consider it necessary to increase the conversion efficiency of the motor in order to handle heavy duty turntables, so we have adopted a 3-phase switching plane drive motor with an 8-pole 6-coil structure.Since all installed coils and all installed rotors are used all the time, torque ripple is small and high efficiency is realized. This reduces the gain of the amplifier in the feedback loop and reduces the influence of drift.The Center shaft is made of hard stainless steel with a diameter of 10and is 450kg Ï‰ cm.2It drives the large moment of inertia turntable stably.450kg / cm2It uses a large inertia turntable, which locks by inertia and locks by quartz at the same time to prevent uneven rotation during actual performance where the record needle is traced by the needle tip.A quartz PLL system is used to control the phase difference by comparing the reference signal of the quartz oscillator with the speed detection signal of the motor.An FG coil that generates power by changing the magnetic flux density of the magnet rotor is used for rotation speed detection, and a newly developed IC with a digital memory inside the IC is used for speed control system.Unlike the conventional sample-and-hold method, temperature characteristics and stability are improved by eliminating the use of coils and resistors.It uses an auto-up mechanism that detects angular velocity by projecting light from an LED toward a mirror attached to the tone arm axis and receiving the returned light with a photo reflector.Since it does not use mechanical contact points or magnets, it is not affected by internal transformers, etc. and performs accurate and quiet auto-up operation.In addition, the turntable keeps rotating for approximately 4seconds after auto-up to protect the needle tip.Cartridge is not included."

description:
## Description

"A record player developed in pursuit of the theme of picking up the information inscribed on the disc as it is.The turntable section focuses on transient load fluctuations that cannot be controlled by the servo circuit alone. Diameter 330mm, Weight 2.6kg, Finished mass 440kg / cm2It uses a heavy duty turntable (including rubber sheet). By driving this turntable with a 20-pole 30-slot motor with very low torque ripple, the transient load that occurs when the pickup traces a sound groove with a large dynamic range is also suppressed. Unlike the wow flutter, which is considered to be a periodic load fluctuation, by controlling the non-periodic transient load, the amplitude of the sound groove can be captured more accurately.In order to suppress torque ripple of the motor, the weight of the cabinet is increased by installing MC material and 1.6mm thick steel plate on the back of the cabinet using hard chip board.MC material is a concrete made by adding asbestos and molding it under high pressure. It has very low water absorbency and moisture content and high rigidity. This not only eliminates howling, but also reduces disturbance and provides sound quality in a wide frequency range and low frequency range.A dual suspension type absorber is used for the insulator.This absorber has a unique structure with low rigidity in the longitudinal direction and high rigidity in the lateral direction, reducing vibration in both the longitudinal and lateral directions. In particular, it reduces lateral vibration that occurs when a turntable with a large inertial mass is driven by a motor with a large starting torque.The dust cover is made of acrylic material with a large vibration damping ratio. In addition, the top wall is made thicker and ribs are provided inside each corner to increase rigidity and suppress split vibration.For the arm pipe part of the tone arm, an aluminum pipe with a diameter of 10� and a thickness of 1mm is treated with hard anodized aluminum. In addition, it is supported by brass with a large vibration damping rate to suppress split vibration.In addition, the shell finger is made of aluminum die cast that is molded integrally with the head shell. In addition, a rib is provided at the lower part of the finger to increase rigidity and suppress split vibration.A 6mm thick rubber sheet is used for the rubber sheet of the turntable, and the split vibration is suppressed by pursuing adhesion.The cartridge uses DM-11, a DM (dual magnet) cartridge.By making the mass of the vibration system as small as possible, this cartridge eliminates the resonance frequency of the split vibration from outside the audible band, thereby improving the resolution of the high-frequency range and improving the transient response to a pulsed input."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"A direct drive player with a quartz PLL control circuit.A direct drive system is adopted for the turntable part.The quartz PLL system protects rotational accuracy from steady load (static load with very low frequency component), time drift and temperature drift, and 550kg Ï‰ cm for random transient load with high frequency component.2Steady rotation is maintained by corresponding with moment of inertia of.A double (magnetic and mechanical) integration type 180slot 3-layer gear is used for the servo detection part of the quartz PLL circuit. In addition, the Speed-Volt (S-V) conversion method is used to convert the rotational speed of the turntable as it is into voltage. This makes the servo response linear and increases the response of the quartz PLL circuit to random and slight load fluctuations.Taking into consideration the effect of the eccentricity and twist of the turntable Center shaft on the sound, a 10� Center shaft is adopted, and the turntable shaft is used as a motor shaft as it is.The turntable sheet applies the principle of the Helmholtz resonance box. A small port is provided on the front surface of the table sheet and a resonance space is provided on the back surface of the table sheet to absorb the split vibration generated by the phonograph record.We have also studied the materials used to hold the turntable and the record board together when playing a record in order to improve rotational accuracy.By using MC material for the cabinet, the total weight is increased and vibration of the cabinet due to the reaction of the turntable is suppressed.Dual suspension absorbers are used for the legs.The dual suspension absorber is a unique system with less rigidity in the longitudinal direction and greater rigidity in the lateral direction. This reduces the lateral vibration that occurs when a turntable with a large moment of inertia is driven by a motor with a large starting torque, while at the same time maintaining the elasticity of the absorber from the heavy cabinet.A digital control system using a flip-flop circuit is adopted for the rotation number selector switch and start / stop switch.The power switch is independent of the start / stop selector switch and linked with the power indicator.The quartz lock indicator lights when the turntable rotates normally and the PLL system is locked.The brake part is equipped with a pure electronic brake, which realizes flexible deceleration by suppressing harmful vibration peculiar to mechanical brake.The arm base uses a collet chuck type with large mechanical impedance to suppress resonance.The tone arm adopts TA-71which is an elastic coupling mass separation type tone arm.The tone arm is affected by two disturbances with different levels and frequencies : arm resonance and first order split resonance. The arm resonance and first order split resonance are out-of-phase vibrations in the main weight section, and it was said that it was impossible to control them simultaneously. The TA-71was jointly developed by Trio and NHK Technical Research Institute. It cancels the arm resonance and first order split resonance at the same time. It improves sound quality by increasing howling margin and suppressing low-frequency resonance with a high level.For the internal wiring of the tone arm TA-71, the silk-wound Pentlitz wire of ?? structure with less DC impedance, additional capacitance, and additional inductance is used to improve the channel separation."

name: KENWOOD
description:
## Description

"This is an analog player that uses Kenwood'Ωs original technology and aims at the expression of silence that was difficult for analog players to express.It is equipped with a high-rigidity mechanical short circuit that clarifies the fulcrum of the motor and arm. The motor and arm are made rigid with the frame to form a reproduction circuit that picks up sound.In addition, the transformer, which generates vibration, the cabinet, which is susceptible to vibration, and the dust cover are made of a unified aluminum die-cast frame that floats completely from the regenerative circuit.As a result, the motor support point and the arm support point can be clearly defined, vibration caused by the sound pressure of the speaker and vibration from the floor are completely eliminated, and the muddy sound is greatly improved.With Kenwood'Ωs unique DS (dynamic stability) tone arm, it has a unique knife edge that firmly fixes the fulcrum.As a result, even if the needle tip traces any large signal groove, the supporting point of the tone arm is not pulled in the direction of rotation so that it can trace the sound groove.Uses a DL (Dynamic Center Lock) motor to lock the spindle to the absolute center point of rotation.With a special oil slit cut in the outer diameter surface of the spindle, it is fixed on the spindle rotation axis by force using the pressure of the fluid, and the absolute center point of rotation is maintained.As a result, excellent wow flutter is obtained, and since there is no worn part, deterioration does not occur even after long-term use.A 2-phase sinusoidal wave method is adopted for the drive circuit.In addition, we have developed a twin current square servo circuit with three closed loops to control the effective value of the current flowing in the motor, thereby reducing the wow flutter in the ultra-low range and preventing torque fluctuations.An elastic body with special vibration damping characteristics is used to float the cabinet so that the vibration of the cabinet is not transmitted to the frame. name: Trio
description:
## Description

"A record player with a belt, idler and double drive system.A belt, idler and double drive system is used as the drive system. This is a combination of the belt drive system and drive system and the idler drive system. It combines the newly developed 80mm diameter large idler, 32cm diameter turntable, and 8mm width silicon belt with precision polishing on both sides. This system realizes the performance taking advantage of the advantages of both systems.The Center shaft is made of stainless steel with very low friction. By applying precision polishing treatment to the surfaces, the contact surface between the shaft and bearing is reduced and friction is further prevented. In addition, 4-mm-thick polyurethane is embedded in the bottom of the bearing to absorb the vibration of the motor.The bearings are completely sealed and free from foreign matter. In addition, the surface of the shaft is provided with a spiral groove in the order of microns. When the shaft begins to rotate, molybdenum disulfide, a lubricant, travels through the groove, and the surface of the shaft is always evenly covered.Because molybdenum disulfide has negative electrical characteristics, it is easily adsorbed on metal surfaces with positive characteristics. By using molybdenum disulfide as a lubricant, friction is reduced and smooth rotation without uneven rotation is achieved.A 4-pole synchronous motor is used for the drive part. In addition, the power supply voltage is slightly lowered to ease the motor vibration during rotation.An aluminum die-cast turntable with a diameter of 32cm is used for the turntable.The tone arm uses a static balance type.All audio codes and head shell plug-ins conform to EIA standards.A MM type cartridge is used.In consideration of the relationship between the friction of the idler shaft and oil, we have developed and adopted a special oil for the idler.As a result, the clay does not change even if the temperature changes.A lever is used for switching between 50Hz and 60Hz.This lever can be operated from the top of the player simply by removing the turntable. description:
## Description

"A bookshelf type speaker system developed with the aim of reproducing high fidelity musical quality.A 25cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In order to improve the frequency characteristics in the mid - and high-frequency range, this unit uses a diaphragm made of corn paper made of Canadian kraft pulp and coated with titanium oxide to obtain excellent transient characteristics. The voice coil does not come out of the magnetic circuit even at large amplitude, making it possible to play music without distortion.A non-resonance chamber with a thick cloth substrate is used for the chamber, and while suppressing abnormal resonance in the high-frequency range, it has strength in the low-frequency range at the time of large amplitude. In addition, the dome part requires ideal characteristics such as strength in the low frequency range and sound dispersion in the high frequency range. By using a thick cloth coated with rubber three times and having no dome deformation against amplitude in the low frequency range and excellent characteristics in the high frequency range, wide-band characteristics from 200Hz to 10,000Hz are obtained.The Scoker damper has also been reconsidered. In order to move the resonance frequency of the damper to the higher side while maintaining sufficient strength against amplitude, the shape of the damper is S-shaped like the one used at the edge and the damper width is reduced.The air chamber of the dome part acts as a compliance component at the time of amplitude in the low range and causes the low range distortion. In order to prevent this, a 10mm hole is provided in the pole piece to let the compliance component generated in the dome part escape to the back of the magnet.The frame has a die-cast finish.A 5cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.In this unit, the upper limit of the reproduction frequency is raised by reducing the angle of the neck part of the cone paper, and the dead weight of the cone paper is reduced to 0.1g. In addition, by removing the damper and reducing the distance between the voice coil and the neck of the cone paper as much as possible, a high-efficiency tweeter with excellent start-up characteristics and sharp sharpness is realized.A die-cast frame is used for the frame to eliminate resonance of the frame and sound fog.In the network section, a large ferrite core coil with low DC resistance of 3mH and 0.40� is used for the coil connected in series with the woofer. A large metalized ????? capacitor with 20Ï‰ F is used for the capacitor connected in series with the squaker. The coil with low loss is effective for improving damping, and the large capacitor with good distortion characteristics is effective for smooth sound music playback.All of the baffle plate, back plate, side plate, and roof plate of the enclosure use a single laminated lumber core. The lumber core as a core material and the single plates as both side plates take advantage of each other'Ωs physical properties to form an enclosure with high Young'Ωs modulus and excellent vibration damping rate.As for internal reinforcement, we have designed the enclosure so that the resonance Q of the enclosure is low, rather than increasing the number of reinforcement materials. "This speaker system is the second generation of the LS series equipped with a Japanese paper dome unit.A 25cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.A CF cone is used for the diaphragm of this unit. By this, while taking advantage of the sound quality of the CF cone, which is simple and voluminous, with little peculiarity, we have improved the texture in the low sound range and sharpness.The edge uses an asymmetric S-shaped edge that combines the advantages of a roll type and a reverse roll type. This reduces the amplitude distortion because the same force is applied to the amplitude of the voice coil. In addition, the surface where the voice coil contacts the pole piece is reduced, and the third harmonic distortion in the middle range can also be reduced. In addition, a hole is made in the center of the pole piece to release the air in the chamber, greatly improving the amplitude distortion.For the core paper of voice coil, hard TLP with high Young'Ωs modulus and propagation speed is adopted.A 5cm dome type skoker is installed in the middle area.The diaphragm is made of a mixture of CF pulp and Ganpishi to create a thin and strong diaphragm. The diaphragm made of CF pulp is lighter than soft domes and metallic domes, so it has high efficiency and provides a damping mid-range. In addition, an asymmetrical S-shaped edge is used for the edge section to provide a smooth amplitude and a low-frequency range with low distortion and good start-up.A T-shaped pole piece is used in the magnetic circuit to obtain a uniform magnetic field, and in addition, a high magnetic flux density of 14,000gauss is realized. In addition, the back pressure of the dome part is released by opening a large diameter hole of 20� in the pole piece. In addition, holes for air release are provided in the top plate and back plate to eliminate the resonance of the air chamber in the edge.The Skoker unit has an iron molded 150cc back cavity to achieve fo = 350Hz, and resonance prevention rubber is attached to the cavity to reduce distortion.A 2.5cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm of this unit is made of Japanese paper (Ganpishi), which has a higher Young'Ωs modulus and a higher propagation speed than Western paper. Since the fiber of this Ganpishi is thin and long, it can be processed thinly while maintaining its strength. It is also more advantageous than metals in terms of weight-to-strength ratio. In addition, it is superior in terms of high-frequency resonance because it has an appropriate internal loss. The diaphragm is made of stainless wool, which has a higher specific gravity than glass wool, so that the sound quality is rolled by t.A T-shaped pole piece is used in the magnetic circuit to achieve uniform magnetic flux density. At the same time, sound absorbing material is put in the cavity between the magnet and pole piece to brake, and the Q of the fo resonance is lowered to improve sharpness.For the frame part, we have adopted a projecting frame in which the dome part protrudes in front of the baffle. This improves the rise-up characteristics of the tweeter and realizes a tweeter with good damping. In addition, reflection in the high-frequency range is less likely to occur, and frequency characteristics are also improved. In addition, by inserting an diffuser using micron glass between the pretector and the diaphragm, the high-frequency range is moderately suppressed, and flat characteristics and directivity are improved.The network section is designed for repeated trial listening with an emphasis on sound quality, and a film condenser is used for the condenser.The attenuator is a continuously variable type with constant inductance so that it can be operated from the front.The front and rear baffles are made of lumber core material, giving a clear and natural sound quality characteristic of muku material. description:
## Description

"This is a 3-way speaker system that pursues what power linearity should be for music.Output sound pressure deviation of ¥2dB is achieved over the frequency range from 65Hz to 16kHz.A 33cm cone woofer is installed in the low range.This unit improves the power linearity by equalizing the magnetic flux distribution in the magnetic circuit. The magnetic circuit is equipped with a needle type yoke and an Alnico cast magnet. The needle type yoke is more uniform in the magnetic flux distribution because the opposed area of the gap between the plate and the pole piece is equal compared with the conventional yoke. The magnetic force of the magnet can be used effectively to improve the power linearity.In addition, in order to prevent the linearity deterioration caused by the air in the air chamber surrounded by the damper, frame and top plate, a ventilation hole is provided between the damper and frame to flatten the playback response and suppress the third harmonic wave.The CF cone of the diaphragm is coated with titanium oxide to improve the reproduction response. This diaphragm is supported by an S-shaped, asymmetric cross-section, ester urethane foam edge with low anti-resonance.Equipped with 12cm cone type skoker in the middle area.In this unit, the pole piece of the magnetic circuit is cut in a T-shape to obtain a uniform magnetic field, and an air vent is provided between the damper, frame and top plate to suppress the 3rd harmonic wave.The cone paper is designed based on the results of optical measurement of the amplitude at the time of large input. It uses an expanded curved cone developed based on the conclusion that it is preferable to limit the movable range of the edge to a value of ¥1.5mm.A horn type tweeter using a ring diaphragm is mounted in the high frequency range.In general horn type tweeters, a dome type diaphragm is used. However, in the dome type, the distance between the driving surface of the voice coil and the top of the dome is long and the strength is weak. Therefore, the piston does not move at high frequencies, and many peaks and dips are generated in frequency characteristics, which leads to deterioration of linearity and adversely affects the transient response.The LS 505tweeter diaphragm uses a V-shaped ring diaphragm molded with super duralumin. By shortening the distance from the driving surface to the edge, the frequency at which split vibration occurs becomes higher, high-frequency resonance is less likely to occur, and the transition from the piston vibration band to the split vibration band becomes smooth and flat. The V-shaped diaphragm further improves linearity by providing small V-shaped edges on the inner and outer periphery.The magnetic circuit uses an 80¥20mm ferrite magnet with a magnetic flux density of 15,000gauss. The air chamber between the pole piece and magnet is filled with micron glass wool to prevent sound reflection and improve damping characteristics.Litz wire step-down attenuator is used for the level control part.A continuously variable attenuator was used for the level control of conventional speaker systems. However, this method has a problem in that sound quality deteriorates at the position of the volume level. When the speaker is driven by the input from the amplifier, a back electromotive force is generated in the voice coil and returned to the amplifier, resulting in a state in which damping is heard well. However, when the continuously variable attenuator is reduced, the DC resistance between the amplifier and the speaker increases, reducing the damping factor and causing sound quality deterioration.The LS 505uses a step-down attenuator using Litz wire to suppress the deterioration of the damping factor due to the step position. This attenuator has the advantage that it does not produce skin effect even at high frequencies, extends the high-frequency range, and does not affect the frequency characteristics of the attenuator by the impedance characteristics in the middle and high-frequency range.In the LS 505, the phase distortion near the crossover between the tweeter and the skoker is also taken into consideration, and the sound source of the skoker and the tweeter is designed to be on the same plane. This prevents deterioration of the playback response due to phase distortion near the crossover.High-density homogen chipboard is used for the side and top and bottom plates of the enclosure, and Yonematsu lumber core with excellent strength and damping characteristics is used for the baffle plate and back plate. The enclosure with excellent damping characteristics is realized by considering the arrangement of reinforcing materials.In addition, a standing wave canceler (SWC) is installed in the bass reflex duct to suppress standing waves that degrade mid-range characteristics and obscure mid-range sound quality."
