description:
## Description

"A speaker system with greatly improved dynamic distortion by pursuing reaction stability that does not allow vibration other than the diaphragm and by examining all the components of the speaker.A 28cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This woofer diaphragm is made of highly rigid ribbed cone paper with thermal shock treed cone ribs. The LS-1000diaphragm is made of stronger and less inner loss, thus achieving more faithful reproduction.The unit is fixed using a Bio-net chuck method, which is similar to the lens mount of a single-lens reflex camera, in which a baffle plate is tightened and fixed. name: KENWOOD
description:
## Description

"A compact speaker system with point sound and a sense of localization and sound field that is unique to compact speakers.A 19cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made of reinforced polypropylene with well-balanced internal loss and rigidity. The diaphragm shape is made of a paracurve cone to suppress resonance in shape. In addition, a damping material is coated on the outer periphery of the back surface of the diaphragm to prevent resonance and flatten the characteristics.In addition, by adopting a large ¥120mm AFC (Advanced Feed Constellation) damper, miniaturization and high reliability have been achieved in a large amplitude speaker unit.The high frequency band is equipped with a 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter that adopts neodymium magnet for magnetic circuit.Neodymium magnets are mainly composed of rare earth elements neodymium and iron / boron. The maximum energy product, which is an indication of the characteristics of the magnet, is 9times larger than that of ferrite magnets. Therefore, while being small in size, strong energy is obtained.In addition, in order to realize the directivity of the unit, wide band and low distortion, a magnetic fluid (Ferrofluid) is adopted. The magnetic fluid developed by NASA is a liquid containing extremely small magnetic particles (magnetite) with an average diameter of 100angstrom. Although it is liquid, it is fully magnetized in the magnetic circuit and does not flow out due to gravity or vibration. By filling the gap of the magnetic circuit with this, Q is lowered due to the damping effect due to viscosity, impedance of the lowest resonance frequency fo is flattened, low-frequency dubbing is realized, and distortion is reduced. In addition, the voice coil is stabilized in the center of the gap by the centering effect of the magnetic fluid, and second and third harmonic distortion is reduced by the synergistic effect with the damping effect.The tweeter is made into a horizontally long rectangular unit shape miniaturized by a neodymium magnet, and the woofer frame is designed into the smallest shape with only the fixed part of the unit being stretched out, so that the interval between the units is minimized and ignition is achieved.It is a magnetic shielding design, and there is no adverse effect on the side of CRT, etc.The network section uses Ritz pattern printed circuit boards, German-made film capacitors, and extra-thick OFC material coils for high-quality transmission.High-rigidity NF ceramics cabinet is adopted for the cabinet.NF ceramics is a ceramic that is formed by chemical bonding using water as a medium without the need for baking treatment in conventional ceramic manufacturing processes. It is composed mainly of lime, silica, etc., and by chemical bonding, high-quality fillers (aggregates) are wrapped in a bonding material with very few defects. It has high damping properties, elastic modulus, and rigidity.By using this NF ceramics, the frequency band of radiated sound other than direct radiated sound is narrower and the radiation time is shorter than conventional materials, and a high S / N ratio is obtained without coloring music signals.In addition, a round baffle is adopted to suppress the diffraction phenomenon of sound, and a rear duct is adopted for the bass reflex duct.The finish is a veneer finish with urethane resin coating.Voice coil directly connected chamber is adopted.Gold plated input terminal corresponding to banana terminal is adopted.Separately sold speaker stand for LS-CX7is available.The same NF ceramics as the LS-CX7body is used for the top and bottom, and the energy radiated from the speaker is received without any coloring.In addition, we have adopted a natural wood core material with a group (also used as a channel for speaker cable) on the back to prevent surface waves from coming around, and a ripple design molding that does not transmit floor resonance, centered on a strut with a thrust plate finish.In addition, a fixing bolt is attached to clarify the vibration earth by integrating with the speaker body."

In addition, the voice coil bobbin and dome part are integrated to prevent transmission loss, and a unique DSD with improved performance as a squaker unit is mounted.In addition, the magnetic circuit is equipped with a large ¥156mm strontium magnet, and the frame uses a composite anti-vibration frame made of iron and aluminum.A hard dome tweeter of 2.5cm is adopted for the high range.For the diaphragm of this tweeter, crystal plasma diamond diaphragm is used, which is a further development of plasma diamond diaphragm made of diamond and titanium base material, and various acoustic constants are improved. In addition, spherical wave horn baffle with good sound radiation characteristics is installed to improve directional characteristics.In addition, in order to improve the SN ratio, it is equipped with a direct inner Class A suspension that eliminates unnecessary edge radiation, and transmission loss is suppressed by the integrated structure of voice coil and dome.In the LS-G5000, we have taken measures for fixing the unit to the front baffle, taking into consideration the adverse effects caused by fixing the unit to the front baffle.In order to prevent harmful vibrations from occurring in the front baffle due to the amplitude of the woofer unit, a 50mm thick front baffle is sandwiched by die casts and tightened strongly from the front and back using a super press lock mounting method.Since the front baffle can be fixed several times more firmly than the system in which the front baffle is simply fixed with a screw, the vibration supporting point is clarified, enabling sound reproduction at lower frequencies more firmly.In addition, a high-rigidity vibration-proof top plate with an exceptionally large top plate is directly attached to the baffle plate to reduce the vibration of the unit.In addition, in order to prevent the surface wave vibration from the woofer transmitted through the front baffle and to prevent the diffuse reflection of the sound emitted from the squaker and the tweeter, an extremely thin and deep groove of 0.6mm width and 10mm depth is cut around the squaker and the tweeter by woodworking technology using laser beams.In order to increase the rigidity of the enclosure, the front baffle plate is 50mm thick and 20mm baffle reinforcement plates are used around the skauker and tweeter to prevent the effect of the back pressure of the woofer.In addition, the back plate has a pyramidal structure to suppress the generation of standing waves in the cabinet, and the front baffle has a round on both sides to improve the diffraction phenomenon.In order to eliminate transmission loss in the network section, we use extra-thick oxygen-free copper cables for internal wiring, large coils made of large silicon steel core materials for coils, and large electrolytic capacitors and solderless caulescent wires to prevent energy loss.In addition, considering crosstalk distortion between networks and between units and networks, we have adopted a distributed network by band.There was a special speaker stand sold separately."

description:
## Description

"A 200series speaker system developed to take advantage of the characteristics of solid-state amplifiers.The 200Series adopts a design method that adjusts the frequency characteristics of the mid - and high-frequency range to the low-frequency range, unlike the conventional sound decision that makes the middle and high-frequency range 2to 5dB higher than the average sound pressure.As a result, natural and clear sound is realized in all bands.A 30cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In addition, a 16cm cone type squaker is mounted in the middle area.Two specially designed horn type tweeters are installed in the high range.Equipped with 4-step switching tone control on the back.Clear emphasizes the high range slightly, Sweet attenuates the high range slightly, Soft attenuates the mid-high range slightly, and Normal provides the most ideal Hi-Fi sound.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.All parts of the cabinet are sealed with putty to prevent air leakage, and the squaker part is contained in an independent airtight box to prevent interference with the woofer unit.Each unit is fixed from the outside of the front baffle plate with screws and bonded with rubber resin.A new nylon sound-absorbing material is used inside. name: Specification
description:
## Description

"This speaker system is the top model of the 400series.In the conventional design method of speaker systems, it is an orthodox method to raise the average sound pressure in the general mid-range by 2to 5dB. The shortage of the low-range has been compensated by the bass reflex effect. As a result, the sound quality was attractive when compared at the store, but sometimes it became audible when you brought it to your home for a long time.The 400Series is designed to provide rich and natural playback sound even if you listen to it for a long period of time by setting the average sound pressure to 3to 4dB lower than that of conventional orthodox speakers, in addition to making the low-frequency to high-frequency flat characteristics.In addition, through a technical tie-up with bozak Co., Ltd., we have conducted repeated research on the materials and sound quality of bozak speaker corn paper. Based on the results of this research, we have adopted a speaker unit that uses a unique method and determined the degree of mixing and mass.The SC 400supports multi-amp playback by switching the rear terminal.A channel divider is required for multi-amp playback because it is disconnected from the network and directly connected to the unit. For 6dB/oct and 18dB/oct, test the mid-range connection in both forward and reverse directions. For 12dB/oct, connect in opposite phases. In this case, set the crossover frequency to 800Hz and 5kHz.A 38cm cone woofer is installed in the low range and a 16cm cone squaker is installed in the middle range.In addition, two horn type tweeters are installed in the high frequency range.A full-scale LC-type network is used in the network section.In addition, a 3-step switching type tone control is mounted.Homogen material is used for the enclosure, and the internal structure adopts a sealing system, and the squaker part is contained in an independent small sealed box to suppress the interference strain with the woofer. The exterior features a walnut urethane finish.The speaker enclosure is designed to be separated from the base, so that it can be installed vertically or horizontally, and can also be used as a bookshelf without the base.By combining the 400Series and the Matching SR Series cabinets, you can use them with the same dimensions as a stereo set."

description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier uses solid-state circuit technology cultivated in KA-6000and directly connected pure complimentary service circuit in all stages.All stages are directly connected to the main amplifier section, eliminating the coupling capacitor. This makes it possible to amplify from direct current, greatly improving frequency characteristics, and making it possible to apply feedback more deeply. In addition, the output impedance does not rise in the low frequency range due to the output capacitor, and the output impedance is flat from the ultra low frequency range to the high frequency range.In the asymmetric power supply system using an output capacitor, the upper and lower current paths are different. Since the output capacitor is used as the power supply for the lower transistor, the capacitance value is limited and the maximum output in the ultra-low frequency range is reduced. In the KA-7002, the power supply is vertically symmetric so that the output in the ultra-low frequency range is not reduced and stable output is achieved.Since the operation of the transistor is exactly the same in each half cycle of the input signal, crossover distortion and switching pulse components that cannot be avoided in a quasi-output circuit can be circuit can be eliminated, reducing distortion at low complimentary service.In order to improve DC stability, a differential amplifier circuit is composed of transistors with good temperature characteristics for the first stage and pre-drive stage. A zener diode is used to stabilize the supply voltage of the first stage circuit. In addition, 100% DC feedback is applied. This prevents DC from flowing into the voice coil of the speaker, causing mechanical orientation to deteriorate. In this differential amplifier circuit, since two transistors share the emitter resistance, a large amount of feedback is required and self-stability is high. In addition, since this differential amplifier circuit is a direct-coupled circuit, it has excellent phase characteristics and an improved damping factor for the speaker.A 3-stage NF circuit is used for the equalizer amplifier section.The tone control section is a 2-dB step switching type, and the turnover roll-off characteristic can be switched in two steps.In addition, to eliminate slight waviness in the flat position, the flat position is turned off, and tone cancellation can be controlled with both the level knob and the defeat switch.The protection circuit uses a PC detection method with a current limiter that prevents the input signal of the drive stage from being applied when a large current flows through the output transistor, thereby limiting the output transistor current.This circuit operates reliably on both the positive and negative sides of the KA-7002, which uses a two power supply system, and solves the problem of the protection function of the direct connection circuit.Equipped with a cut filter, it can cut noise caused by resonance of the arm, motor goroh, wow flutter, scratches, etc.This filter uses a tantalum solid capacitor with a leakage current of less than 1mA to prevent shock noise when the switch is activated.Equipped with input / output jacks and control volume for 4-channel stereo.In the past, the left and right output were balanced by setting the MODE to MIX and adjusting the sound source to the center of the left and right speakers. However, the KA-7002uses Null Balance, which eliminates sound when the left and right are balanced.This allows you to balance the entire amplifier circuit from the cartridge by operating Null Balance while playing monaural records.The preamp and main amp can be used independently."

description:
## Description

"Integrated amplifier with 2power supply configuration on right and left.The power amplifier consists of a DC amplifier without a capacitor in either the signal system or the NF loop. Therefore, there is no phase rotation so that signals of all frequencies can pass through as they are.The circuit configuration consists of three differential stages using an FET at the first stage and a direct-coupled ICL-OCL DC amplifier at all stages. The FET at the first stage is a dual FET with high input impedance, which eliminates the input capacitor and improves sound quality.In addition, the Class A amplifier stage is a 3-stage amplifier with a large bare gain, so a sufficient amount of NF can be applied. In addition, the CMRR (common-mode signal rejection ratio) is designed to be large. Moreover, the load circuit of the pre-driver stage is made constant current and the bias of the power transistor is used as a stabilizing power supply, so that low distortion factor is maintained over a wide band. Moreover, stable characteristics that are not affected by power supply fluctuations due to sudden large input are realized.The protection circuit is equipped with a double protection circuit using limiter protection and relay unique to TRIO.The equalizer circuit uses a 2-stage direct-coupled ICL type equalizer with 1stage differential and class A amplification of constant current load.The first stage is an FET differential amplified ICL system, which realizes excellent phase characteristics and transient characteristics by eliminating a capacitor from the input, and low distortion factor over a wide band by adopting class A amplification with constant current load circuit.The equalizer uses a 1% resistor and 2% capacitor with an RIAA deviation of ¥0.2dB, and a high signal-to-noise ratio is achieved by selecting the optimum constant using carefully selected low-noise elements.For tone control, the first stage FET ¥2power supply 3-stage direct connection configuration is adopted.This tone control is designed with a low distortion factor so that an in-phase component always appears in the output, including tone jump.The tone jump switch allows direct connection between a flat amplifier and a power amplifier.The power supply section uses a large 190va power transformer with windings separated from the secondary side to the left and right sides, and consists of four 6800Ï‰ F filter Ï‰ F filter capacitors and has a left and right independent configuration.The power supply for the preamp is a full-scale regulator using transistors to reduce interference from the power section to the preamp section.The internal layout has a heat sink in the center to increase the strength of the case, shield the small signal of the class A amplifier from the power supply, and shield the large AC current flowing to the speaker system.The equalizer uses a direct connection directly connected to the input terminal to prevent stray capacitance from adversely affecting the low-level signal from the player.A 7-pin balanced code with L/R on the ground is used for the part from equalizer to tone in.In addition, in order to remove unstable elements from the entire circuit, we have adopted a configuration that does not even use a single shield wire, thereby improving sound quality and achieving stability.Tape dubbing circuit with through circuit is adopted.It uses a -20dB attenuator and a 32-contact attenuator volume.Uses a two step switching type loudness control.The carrying handle in the picture was sold as an optional item sold separately."

## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was developed under the policy of delivering the real thing to those who want the real thing.The equalizer amplifier section uses a 3-stage direct connection circuit consisting of 1stage FET differential amplifier and 2stages PNP + NPN class A amplifier.10at low-noise for first stage differential amplification-9By using an FET with A or less and extremely low gate leakage current, the input capacitor is eliminated and connected directly to the input, eliminating various causes of distortion and noise. This ICL method can greatly improve phase characteristics and transient characteristics, reduces disturbance noise in the ultra-low frequency range caused by the capacitor, and ensures a wide dynamic range with a maximum allowable input of 260mV by applying a high voltage of ¥25V.Second, a 2-stage class A amplifier circuit consisting of PNP + NPN is used to improve the bare gain. Since a sufficient amount of feedback is applied to the low-frequency range, it can obtain both low distortion and excellent equalizer characteristics.For the power amplifier part, all stages are directly connected OCL circuit by first stage PNP differential + class A amplification + constant current + pure complimentary service power Darlington.In addition to the final transistor and complimentary service, the pure complimentary service Power Darlington Block is an original device of Trio. In addition to this device, the Power Darlington Block is equipped with a limiter protection, which is unique to Trio. In this device, the high power is obtained while the no-signal current is adjusted within the Power Darlington Block, and the stability is greatly improved. In addition, the bias of the power transistor is stabilized by making the load circuit of the pre-driver constant current. This stabilizes the bias of the power transistor. The pre-driver load circuit can be used as a stabilized power supply. Thus, the power supply before the pre-driver can be used as a stabilized power supply. It has a wide bandwidth, low distortion rate, and stable characteristics that are not affected by power fluctuations caused by sudden large signal input are obtained.The power supply section uses a power transformer with good regulation and two large capacitors of 15,000Ï‰ F.The protection circuit is a triple protection configuration. It is equipped with an ASO detection type limiter method for protecting the power transistor, a relay for protecting the speaker, and a surge prevention for the power switch circuit.The tone amplifier is a ¥2power supply system using a low-noise operational amplifier. Since it is a selective NFB type tone control, the CR element is in the NF circuit and not in the signal system, so the SN ratio is good and the distortion factor is low.In addition, since the CR element is removed in the tone defeat position, the buffer amplifier has excellent characteristics such as DC stability, distortion and phase.Equipped with a large power meter that employs a logarithmic compression circuit.The meter uses a current sensitive meter of 400Ï‰ A. The meter has an easy-to-read W display and a range switch of 15dB from 0.01W to 100W.The volume section uses a 22-contact attenuator volume and a 3-step attenuator of off/-10dB/-20dB.Equipped with a subsonic filter.There was a carrying handle as an option sold separately."

## Description

"Pre-main amplifier that uses New VIG / DLD circuit and � drive circuit.The New VIG / DLD circuit is a circuit system originally developed by Kenwood, in which a VIG circuit that does not transmit power supply noise components to the power amplifier is installed between the amplifier and the power supply, and the performance of the DLD circuit improves the quality. By this circuit system, ripple, signal components and intermodulation distortion components from the power supply are cut off, and clean energy is supplied to the power amplifier. At the same time, the effect equivalent to that of a huge battery is obtained, and power capacity is increased by a large power supply without ripple.In the � drive, the NF loop is connected to the speaker terminal, so that parts which cause distortion and sound quality degradation are put in the NF loop, and the generation of distortion is suppressed.In addition, all GND terminals are concentrated at one point on the speaker terminal of the amplifier, mutual interference by ground line pattern and wire material is suppressed, and digital noise generated from peripheral devices is also released to the outside of the amplifier through the ground line.The EQ amplifier has an ICL high GmFET differential input and IC-based circuit configuration.The input signal from the CD can be sent directly to the power amplifier by the CD direct circuit and the line straight circuit that passes the tone control.It is equipped with a dual REC selector that combines the conventional Rec out selector function with the source selector function.This allows you to record CDs while listening to a tuner, record dubbing on two tapes while listening to CDs, and record the same source simultaneously on Route 3tapes.A flexible flat cable is used for wiring from the input pin jack to the input selector.Since this cable has less inductance, capacitance, and resistance components than conventional cables, it can reduce electromagnetic coupling between an output circuit for handling large signals and an input circuit for handling small levels, and realizes low distortion.Also, since the spacing between the wires is fixed, there is less interference between the left and right channels and between input positions, and less wire routing, resulting in improved channel separation and crosstalk."

## Description

"An integrated amplifier designed to provide more pure sound quality with a thorough anti-vibration design.We have newly developed and adopted a strut air suspension to suppress noise and distortion caused by external vibration.This suspension is a unique independent suspension vibration absorption system. At the same time, it achieves the same effect as a huge battery. The ripple free large power supply greatly increases the power supply capacity.The internal structure employs a 5-box logical flow construction. The shield plate completely separates the small signal and large signal, digital signal and analog signal, and each signal processing part and power supply to suppress mutual interference.In addition, by placing the transformer in the center, the merits of the strut air suspension can be maximized, and vibration damping effect is also improved.The heat sink uses a chimney type heat sink with excellent heat radiation effect and vibration isolation.Equipped with a � drive circuit that reduces distortion.In the � drive, the NF loop is connected to the speaker terminal of the amplifier, and parts which cause distortion and sound quality degradation are put in the NF loop, and generation of distortion is suppressed.In addition, all GND lines are concentrated at one point on the speaker terminal of the amplifier to suppress mutual interference caused by ground line patterns and wires, and to prevent digital noise generated by peripheral devices.Dual Rec Selector with Source Selector function and CD Direct Switch are installed."

name: KA-7090R
description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier using TRIATR.The conventional A-class amplifier had an ideal A-class operation when viewed from a long-time level. However, at the moment of signal change, the temperature inside the transistor changed significantly. This temperature change could not be detected by a normal temperature detector, making it difficult for even an A-class amplifier to maintain the ideal operating point.To solve this problem, we have independently developed and adopted the Thermally Reactive Advanced Instantaneous Transistor (TRAITR).The TRAITR is the world'Ωs first single-chip high-speed thermal-responsive transistor with a built-in temperature detection and correction circuit in a power transistor. By detecting and correcting the temperature inside the transistor, excellent road characteristics are obtained and tracking performance to the strength of the music signal is improved.As a result, the distortion factor does not vary depending on the output, and low distortion of bare characteristics is realized in the practical use area.In order to realize a clean ground line, electrostatic coupling prevention structure is adopted.In this structure, the radiator is not electrically connected to the chassis, but is directly connected to the reference ground on the power transformer side so that dirty signals are directly returned to the power supply circuit.This prevents the electrostatic coupling current from flowing into the ground line, resulting in a clean ground line.A relay switching circuit is used for the input switching circuit.This prevents deterioration of sound quality and aging of contact points caused by rust.It has a source direct circuit that bypasses the tone control circuit when it is not in use.Uses gold-plated input terminal.A remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier that adopts TRAIT.This is the first time in its class to be equipped with TRAIT, which succeeded in integrating temperature detection and compensation circuits into one chip for the first time in the world.In the conventional configuration in which the temperature detection transistor is attached to the radiator externally, the operating point always changes depending on the output size, resulting in a mismatch in the amplification factor of the music signal and distortion especially in the case of small signals.In TRAIT, the temperature detection element detects the temperature of the transistors in almost real time because the transistors are placed on the same chip. This temperature detection element enables the realization of a thermal feedback system in which the operating state of the transistors is always ideal.In order to solve the problem of ground line, pure signal ground line is adopted.This allows only a pure signal to flow through the main ground line, reducing the noise components that pollute the music signal.With the aim of minimizing the signal path, it uses logical flow construction with internal layout along the signal flow. This reduces the interference between the large signal part and the small signal part or power supply part, and improves sound quality.The printed circuit the printed circuit board is also fixed in a soft manner so that it has a vibration resistant structure that is less susceptible to vibration.A source direct circuit is installed to bypass the tone control and balance control circuits when they are not used.It has a phono equalizer jack for MM.Equipped with a loudness control.Wireless remote control is included."

name: L-A1
description:
## Description

"This integrated amplifier was announced as the first of the new L series with the aim of becoming a new standard model in the 90'Ωs.Super C with reduced in-phase noise is used in the first stage amplifier.4Circuit is mounted.In general, a differential amplifier circuit is used for the first stage to cancel noise from the power supply circuit by differential operation.4The amplifier realizes differential amplification of only signal components by active operation of not mixing but not canceling, and achieves extremely high in-phase component rejection ratio (CMRR). Moreover, the amplifier transistor can always maintain a constant Pc (collector loss), and the element can be kept in an ideal operating state.In addition, this circuit board is placed close to the volume in order to be completely isolated from the output stage of the power amplifier and the power supply circuit, which are noise sources, to suppress intermodulation of the signal and degradation of S/N.Quadrive Multiple Final Stage is used for the output stage.In the conventional model, even in the high-grade model in which the number of final transistors was arranged in parallel in multiple stages, the configuration of the driver stage immediately before was configured by a single connection, and the overall head room was limited.In the Quad Multiple Final Stage, a dedicated driver is provided for each final transistor to distribute the load of each transistor, improve the linearity of the driver stage, and increase the overall margin, thereby improving the drive performance of low-impedance speakers.In addition, we pay attention to the radiation of each stage by separating the circuit boards of the final stage, which handles high power, and the driver stage, which handles low power, into the front and back of the heat sink.The pre-driver stage and driver stage are class A operation to suppress the generation of switching distortion and achieve thermal stability.The volume uses a fully shielded ultra-low impedance resistor rotating volume. By rotating the slider and rotating the disk-shaped resistor, the number of contacts is reduced and high sound quality is achieved.The impedance is 1k ¥, which corresponds to 1/100of the normal impedance, and thermal noise is suppressed to 1/10. In addition, the volume and peripheral circuits are contained in the divided air-chamber frame to eliminate the influence of the output of the power amplifier, power supply circuit and sound pressure.It is equipped with a VIG circuit (voltage interface gate) to cut out noise components and supply pure energy to the amplifier circuit.This circuit has a low impedance when viewed from the amplifier side and a high impedance when viewed from the power supply side. This circuit has the property of passing only DC energy from the current and cutting noise components.This eliminates power supply ripple, signal components, and intermodulation distortion components, enabling pure energy supply.The power supply section uses a large toroidal transformer with a capacity of 450VA and a high-quality aluminum electrolytic capacitor.Instead of the usual gain switching method, discrete amplifiers matching the characteristics of the MC and MM cartridges are mounted on the first stage of the equalizer amplifier.Dedicated elements with different characteristics are cascode-connected, such as FET elements for the high-output, high-impedance MM type and bipolar elements for the low-output, low-impedance MC type.The body frame and bottom plate are made of 2mm thick bottom mm thick bottom plate, which is strong enough to suppress the vibration of the power supply and heat sink. In addition, the selector / equalizer amplifier part, voltage amplification power supply part, power amplification power supply part, volume / Super C4The four air chambers of the (main amplifier / first stage amplifier) part are divided by the same 2mm thick steel plate to prevent mutual interference of each part and to increase rigidity.It is equipped with a control microcomputer for relay control and electric volume control.In order to prevent these digital signals for clock control from entering analog circuits and causing deterioration of sound quality, a dedicated small transformer is installed. In addition, all control systems extracted from the microcomputer are isolated using photocouplers (optical coupling).A high-hardness glass epoxy board is used for the printed circuit board.In addition, the board is rigidly mounted to a 2mm thick frame via steel studs to improve reliability.The panels, volume knobs, input selector knobs and keys are made of either cutting materials or extruded materials with sufficient thickness to improve operability and achieve high rigidity and reliability.The front panel, which is most exposed to sound pressure, is made of 5mm thick aluminum extruding.In addition, the pin jack adopts a high-reliability type with gold-plated brass.The volume knob made of machined aluminum has an indicator for attenuation level, allowing for delicate volume adjustment.In addition, there is a high visibility spot light which is easy to check the fine adjustment level.The Input/Rec out selector is laid out to minimize the inductance component by suppressing the electromagnetic coupling from the output stage that handles high power. It is placed near the pin jack. Transmission loss is reduced by using a high-performance gold contact small inert gas sealed type relay, and crosstalk is completely suppressed by using pure copper bus bar for ground.The signal selected by the selector is input to the line buffer amplifier at the shortest distance, converted to low impedance, and then input to the volume.The normally used input selector is indicated by the red LED indicator at the top of the knob.When it functions as a Rec Out, it turns amber. When the Rec Out is turned off, everything goes out.Equipped with balanced input terminal.Remote control unit is included."

"The TW-80A -80A, this is a top-of-the-line stereo pre-main amplifier designed for more ideal original sound reproduction.Mesa silicon transistors are used from the equalizer amplifier to the preamplifier.We have improved various characteristics such as frequency characteristics, S / N ratio and damping factor by adopting a mesa silicon transistor that is resistant to heat and can be used semipermanently.NF-type tone control is used for the tone control.In addition, this tone control board is made into a block and can be removed with one touch.The equalizer amplifier section uses a direct-coupled amplifier without capacitors or resistors to prevent the sound quality degradation that occurs when capacitors or resistors are inserted between stages.It is equipped with a protection circuit that protects the power transistor and also repeatedly checks the safety of the circuit during its operation.There is no need to worry about failure as it is a pure electronic type without using relays, etc.There was a connection adapter with a DIN standard connector sold separately."
